label: Some bearer of some occurring thought has one of four outcome forms: its support ancestry is…
paraphrase: Some bearer of some occurring thought has one of four outcome forms: its support ancestry is accessible with a terminus satisfying the supplied substance predicate; accessible with a terminus failing it; contains a support cycle; or has an endless ancestor set and no cycle. Coverage only: the terminus forms are not exclusive of each other, and a terminus failing the predicate is not thereby a process.
